kehillah_reform_enact_effect = {
    kehillah_reform_resolve_pending_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { kehillah_reform_choice_valid_trigger = yes }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = kehillah_synod_applied value = yes }
        custom_tooltip = kehillah_reform_enacted_tt
        if = {
            limit = { var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:core }
            rite = {
                if = { limit = { exists = prev.var:kehillah_reform_replacement } remove_rite_tenet = prev.var:kehillah_reform_replacement }
                add_rite_tenet = prev.var:kehillah_reform_topic
            }
        }
        else = {
            faith = {
                if = { limit = { prev.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:permit } set_tenet_status = { tenet = prev.var:kehillah_reform_topic status = permitted } }
                else_if = { limit = { prev.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } set_tenet_status = { tenet = prev.var:kehillah_reform_topic status = prohibited } }
                else = { set_tenet_status = { tenet = prev.var:kehillah_reform_topic status = known } }
            }
        }
        faith = { every_faith_rite = { kehillah_standing_refresh_ceilings_rite_effect = yes } }
        rite = {
            if = {
                limit = { var:kehillah_reform_pending_topic ?= prev.var:kehillah_reform_topic }
                remove_variable = kehillah_reform_pending_tenet
                remove_variable = kehillah_reform_pending_topic
                remove_variable = kehillah_reform_pending_action
            }
        }
        kehillah_change_pillar_effect = { PILLAR = greatness AMOUNT = kehillah_synod_passed_greatness }
        debug_log = "SYNOD_REFORM: enacted stored tenet object"
    }
    else = { custom_tooltip = kehillah_reform_lapsed_tt debug_log = "SYNOD_REFORM: lapsed; no tenet removed" }
}
